title: Hearing on oversight of city master agreement contracts
summary: The Council's Committee on Contracts will examine how the city uses master agreements, which let agencies place repeated purchase orders with vendors without separately soliciting each purchase. The hearing follows a May 2026 Comptroller report finding mayoral agencies spent over $8.8 billion through such delivery orders from Fiscal Year 2022 to 2025, overspending registered contract values by more than $1.6 billion, with limited public detail on what was purchased. Testimony is expected from the Mayor's Office of Contract Services, the Comptroller, the Department of Citywide Administrative Services and the Office of Technology and Innovation.
